name: Turbine Mimic (SCADA schematic)
description: Phase 1 MVP: animated turbine schematic driven by live 1 Hz IoTDB telemetry (12 headline sensors) via a Thingsboard device datasource. Rotor rotation tracks TURBINE_SPEED_RPM; hotspots recolor on threshold breach; stale data (>120s, configurable) renders as a distinct DOWN state. See app/thingsboard/widgets/turbine-mimic.js for the canonical source and THINGSBOARD_TURBINE_VIZ_PROMPT.md for scope.
